chapter_title_en: The Weight of a Dragon Robe
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 588: Gao Zhijian's Confession Rejected & the Burden of the Emperor
chapter_meta_description: Gao Zhijian confesses his love to Chun Xiaoman, but she refuses to be Empress. As the Emperor of Great Liang, he must now accept a fate of political marriage, haunted by the fear of the Dice's return.
og_title: The Cost of the Crown: Gao Zhijian's Heartbreak
og_description: A quiet but devastating chapter. Gao Zhijian must choose between love and his dynasty, while the terrifying question of the Dice's survival lingers.
twitter_title: Gao Zhijian Gets Rejected—The Emperor's Lonely Fate
twitter_description: Chun Xiaoman turns down the throne. A heavy chapter on the personal price of imperial power in a twisted world.

lore_anchors.definition: A mysterious figure who oversees the positions of the stars; in the Dao-Twisted World, he acts as a guide between the mortal and divine realms, sometimes appearing in visions.
A traditional Chinese health tonic made from swiftlet nests; in the Dao-Twisted World, it is a symbol of royal care that also carries the unsettling implication of consuming a home.
In Chinese geomancy, the underground energy channel that determines a dynasty's legitimacy; in the Dao-Twisted World, it is a parasitic burden that dictates the Emperor's personal life.
